name: charactercheck

distribution.source: This manifest describes the unreleased checkout containing it.
distribution.published: PyPI latest is the historical 0.6.2 artifact and does not contain this safety contract.
distribution.version_warning: The checkout temporarily retains 0.6.2 metadata; assign a new version before any publication.

description: Unreleased read-only compilation of selected D&D Beyond character fields into mechanical context, canonical assessments, provenance, findings, and versioned snapshots.
boundary: Not complete rules validation, encounter/world/session state, role enforcement, or proof of action legality. No mutations are exposed.
install: pip install charactercheck installs the historical published 0.6.2 contract; run the checkout with python3 -m charactercheck for this unreleased contract

commands.charactercheck derive <ref> [--brief]: selected derivation plus canonical fields, findings, trust, and observation metadata
commands.charactercheck stance <ref>: stance envelope with canonical assessment, findings, trust, and observation metadata
commands.charactercheck qa <ref> [--full]: 100-row Coverage Inventory with closed states; not validity
commands.charactercheck report <ref> [--brief]: canonical fields/trust plus findings and identified feature names
commands.charactercheck snapshot <ref>: export CharacterSnapshotV1 with separate default-mechanical, stored-character, and whole-envelope hashes plus omission coverage
commands.charactercheck diff <ref> --baseline <sn: classify supported changes; distinct snapshots with any omitted-source coverage or restriction semantics fail closed as indeterminate at $
commands.charactercheck quiz <ref>: settlement questions with conservative expected values
commands.charactercheck seatpack <ref> [--for-dm]: privacy-minimized read-only context; --for-dm marks all player-authority live values; persona is local explicit opt-in
commands.charactercheck intake <ref> [--for-dm] [: pre-session context, questions, trust and authority boundary; --for-dm is redaction, not authorization
commands.charactercheck selftest: offline installation and selected-derivation smoke test

accepted: positive 1-20 digit numeric id with no leading zero
direct regular local JSON file where enabled
input.limits: Raw local/remote character payloads: 8 MiB. Local CharacterSnapshotV1 envelopes: 16 MiB. MCP request lines: 8 MiB. All JSON also has bounded depth, nodes, strings, collections, inventory, modifiers, and container traversal.

exit_codes.0: command-specific success; successful projections can still contain non-trusted fields
exit_codes.1: derive/report lint-only, diff named change or indeterminate comparison, or selftest failure
exit_codes.2: derive/report has an unhandled record, or an explicit compatibility flag guard failed; argparse usage errors also use 2
exit_codes.3: structured retrieval/input/snapshot/internal failure, or a failed doctor check

command_exit_contracts.derive/report: 0 no lint/unhandled; 1 lint with no unhandled; 2 one or more unhandled records; 3 structured failure
command_exit_contracts.diff: 0 complete comparison with no detected change; 1 any named change or indeterminate omitted-source/restriction comparison; 3 structured failure
command_exit_contracts.stance/qa/snapshot/quiz/seatpack/intake: 0 when emitted even if fields/findings require attention; 3 structured failure
command_exit_contracts.usage: argparse errors are plain text and exit 2; unsupported command-specific flag combinations are structured and exit 2

privacy.default: mechanical; account identifiers, linked images, appearance, notes, and persona omitted
privacy.persona: explicit authorized local CLI/library opt-in only (--include-persona in the CLI); bounded and marked untrusted
privacy.mcp: no persona opt-in and no host-local file access
privacy.consent: public sharing does not imply model transfer, persistence, training, recurring tests, or publication

snapshot.normalized_data_hash: canonical hash of the default privacy-filtered mechanical character; used as source_revision and excludes persona and omitted fields
snapshot.snapshot_character_hash: canonical hash of the exact filtered character stored in the snapshot; includes persona only after explicit local opt-in
snapshot.snapshot_id: hash of the complete envelope except its own value
snapshot.observed_at: canonical UTC RFC 3339 observation metadata; not a trusted or attested timestamp
snapshot.authenticity: unkeyed hashes are integrity/content identifiers only; they are not signatures, source attestations, trusted timestamps, or authorization evidence

coverage.unclassified_top_level_omitted: boolean only; no omitted name or value is serialized
coverage.unclassified_nested_omitted: boolean only; no omitted name or value is serialized
coverage.semantic_values_omitted: boolean only; fixed field-owned semantic-gap codes route the impact without serializing omitted text
coverage.scoped_mechanical_omissions: sorted canonical family names only; reviewed omitted source field names and values are not serialized

snapshot.derive_invariant: the same typed coverage appears under meta.source_coverage; reviewed display/provenance omissions are trust-neutral, scoped mechanical omissions add source:scoped-fields-omitted for listed families, either unclassified-field flag adds source:unclassified-fields-omitted and routes every mechanical family to unknown, and semantic-value omissions retain fixed gap codes that route known root-item impact to unsupported and unscoped non-item or nested-item impact to global unknown
snapshot.diff_invariant: distinct snapshots with any nonempty omission coverage or omitted modifier restriction semantics emit $ in unsupported_changes and relationship indeterminate; same-revision named non-mechanical deltas are mechanically_unchanged; exact identity is unchanged

library.canonical: package-level derive(ref) and stance(ref) preserve trust and source coverage
library.plain_fetch: fetch(ref) raises source_coverage when returning a plain character would discard omission metadata
library.raw_workspace: build is not package-exported; engine.build also raises source_coverage on incomplete raw sources

mcp.result_contract: generic bounded text plus the tool object in structuredContent
mcp.capabilities: read-only public remote refs; no host-local files, persona opt-in, authenticated principal, role enforcement, or mutation

trust.trusted: no detected finding within supported coverage; not a global safety claim
trust.ask_player: known ambiguity requires the supplied human question
trust.unsupported: observed content has no applicable handler for that family
trust.unknown: observed content has unknown target scope; derived families fail closed
trust.invalid: known content is malformed or contradictory and the value must be declined
trust.precedence: invalid > unknown > unsupported > confirm > trusted; not_applicable is orthogonal

errors.contract: recognized runtime/input failures use safe structured error/message/action/retryable/exit_code with refs, paths, values, and raw detail omitted; argparse usage errors remain plain text
